story.title: We Can Stay Safe
paragraphs_en: Staying Safe and Healthy The COVID-19 virus is affecting our lives. But doctors and nurses and other adults can help us stay safe. Some​ ​of your best friends are here too, to tell you how to take care of your health and help others. With thanks to Anirban Mahapatra, Dr N S Prashanth, Shambhavi Naik and Dr Tanya Seshadri.
Ammachi’s Amazing Advice Written and illustrated by Rajiv Eipe Sooraj and I are staying safe at home. We hope that you are too! Do not go out if you feel unwell.
If we get a fever, a cough, or it gets hard to breathe, we will first call up our doctor or the help line to tell us what to do. I felt sick in my tummy once... I just ate too much!

Why Is Neema Singing Happy Birthday? Written by Bijal Vachharajani Illustrated by Priya Kuriyan Neema stays safe by washing her hands often and well. She uses soap and she sings for 20 seconds. Happy birthday to me, Happy birthday to me, Happy birthday, dear Neema, Happy birthday to me! Happy birthday to me, Happy birthday to me, Happy birthday, dear Neema, Happy birthday to me!

Uma Versus the Virus Written by Meera Ganapathi Illustrated by Renuka Rajiv If you want to cough or sneeze, Make sure you use Atishoo! please. If a tissue can't be found, Hurry, bring your elbow 'round.

Farida Plans to Not Touch Her Face Written by Maegan Dobson-Sippy Illustrated by Jayesh Sivan Farida keeps her hands busy. She shares seeds with the birds. Cheep cheep cheep! “If we don’t touch our faces, then the virus can’t make us sick!” she tells Amma.

Who Returned Bhaiya’s smile? Written by Sanjana Kapur Illustrated by Sunaina Coelho Bhaiya feels the world is getting scary. His monster friend gets bigger and bigger. Dukduk has eaten up Bhaiya's smile. Bhaiya talks to Mama and Papa and plays with Chiru. Then he feels less alone. Now Bhaiya does not have to feel locked up.

Meera and Ameera Keep a Safe Distance Written by Nimmy Chacko Illustrated by Lavanya Naidu Ameera, did you hear? There’s a new virus that makes people very ill! ACHOO! KHAU-KHAU! If we are too close, the virus can jump from them to us. We must stay six feet away. Good thing our paper boat is ready!
Nani’s Staying Inside Her House Written and illustrated by Deepa Balsavar Now is not the time to roam. Nani wants you safe at home. The park can wait another day, Just for now, indoors you stay.
Nani says: Do what’s right. Stay indoors, day and night. And if you can, do a good deed, So many others are in need.

sentences.text_vi: Nani muốn con an toàn ở nhà.
